channel.title: closed:in blog
channel.description: Tactics, teardowns and numbers from B2B outbound campaigns closed:in runs: cold email, Clay workflows, deliverability, GTM engineering.

item.title: Apollo credits explained (2026): plans, what a credit buys and what a contact costs
item.description: Apollo moved to one shared credit pool. What each plan costs in November 2026, how many credits you get, what an email or mobile number costs in credits, and why unused credits are lost.

item.title: Instantly vs Smartlead pricing (2026): cost per email, limits and hidden costs
item.description: Instantly and Smartlead side by side in November 2026: plan prices, contact and email limits, cost per 1,000 emails, and the costs that are not on the pricing page.

item.title: Clay pricing explained (2026): Actions, Data Credits and what a plan really costs
item.description: Clay now bills two things, Actions and Data Credits. What each plan costs in November 2026, how the two meters work, and how to pick a plan without overbuying.

item.title: Best GTM engineering agencies in the Netherlands and Benelux (2026)
item.description: Ten GTM engineering, outbound and demand agencies in the Netherlands and Belgium compared on location, Clay partner status, stack, published pricing and who they fit. Written by an Amsterdam agency, with the criteria out in the open.

item.title: Apple killed open rate. Most agencies still report on it.
item.description: Since iOS 15 Mail Privacy Protection launched in 2021, roughly 60-65% of email "opens" are fake pre-loads by Apple. closed:in dropped open rate from client reports two years ago. Here is what we use instead.

item.title: The cold email warmup schedule that actually works in 2026
item.description: Skip warmup or run it wrong and your domain reputation is dead before you send the first real email. The exact 21-day warmup schedule closed:in uses on every client inbox, plus the 4 traps that wreck deliverability.

item.title: How to find prospects who are not in Apollo or ZoomInfo
item.description: Niche B2B ICPs (boutique retailers, hospitality operators, local service businesses) often do not appear in standard B2B databases. The custom data sourcing pipeline closed:in built for Jamezz that produced 81 qualified leads in 60 days.
